name: Sources
rows: URLs are transcribed only where present in supplied EPA snapshots; no internet retrieval was required.
Lists annual_aqi_by_county_2024.zip (997 rows) and daily_aqi_by_county_2024.zip (329,597 rows), snapshot “As of 2026-06-25”; page says annual/daily are standard EPA time aggregations.

Download page links “Description of data and formats” to FileFormats.html; format page identifies pre-generated file families and documents CSV/FIPS/AQI concepts. County AQI product columns are taken directly from supplied headers.
Supplied PDF; public URL not inferred
Defines six AQI categories and ranges; states final daily AQI takes a full 24 hours, so this exercise is retrospective and not proof the value was known before an activity.
STATEFP + COUNTYFP form 5-digit FIPS; county names verify 04013 Maricopa, 04019 Pima, 04027 Yuma. Identity only, not health outcomes.
Hypothetical costs, weights, monthly budget, daily approval limit, baseline funding, and claims DA-D1/DA-D2.

Daily county table supplies one final county AQI record per observed date; annual county table supplies yearly counts and maxima. We re-aggregate daily AQI and compare, never use annual totals to invent days.
Final daily county AQI used for retrospective simulation. It is not an hourly exposure and not assumed available before activity start.
Supplied text label is retained in raw source; reconciliation is independently determined from numeric AQI boundaries.
Site associated with the defining AQI in the supplied daily record; retained in source but not used to infer countywide individual exposure.
Supplied count of reporting sites for the county/day; audited as a field, not treated as attendance or exposure duration.
Six category counts, Days with AQI, and Max AQI compared field by field to the annual county row.
No asthma causality, no individual/hourly exposure, no real attendance, no weather forecast, and no precise extrapolation to another year.
